Language / Язык (en/ru) [en]: Keys and every password left blank are generated during installation; typed passwords never enter the configuration file.
  fresh   — a clean server: the installer sets up Nginx and takes TCP 80 and 443
  coexist — your Nginx with a `stream` block already owns 443: the installer adds its SNI routes beside yours
  fresh preserves panel client IPs; coexist needs an operator-configured PROXY bridge (see INSTALLER_REFERENCE)
Host mode (fresh/coexist) [fresh]:   core       — the panel and MTProxy (Telegram)
  core-naive — the same plus NaiveProxy
  core-mieru — the same plus Mieru
  full       — the panel, MTProxy, NaiveProxy and Mieru
  AmneziaWG and TrustTunnel are not part of a profile: they are separate questions further below
Proxy Control profile (core/core-naive/core-mieru/full) [full]:   none        — no 3x-ui
  existing    — 3x-ui is already installed: only routes to its VLESS Reality inbounds are added on 443
  managed-new — the installer sets up its own 3x-ui 3.10.2 (VLESS Reality TCP/XHTTP, Hysteria2)
3x-ui mode (none/existing/managed-new) [none]: Panel domain: MTProxy Fake-TLS domain: Client subscription domain (blank to keep subscriptions off): MCP server domain — central panel only (blank to keep MCP off): NaiveProxy domain: Mieru hostname: Mieru TCP ports (comma-separated) [46001]: Mieru UDP ports (comma-separated) [46001]: Enable WARP routing [y/N]: Install the Xray-router (pinned Xray-core 26.10.17; the archive is fetched unless staged in /var/lib/proxy-control; MTProxy can be routed through it from the panel too) [y/N]: Send all NaiveProxy traffic through the Xray-router [Y/n]: Send all Mieru traffic through the Xray-router [Y/n]: Send all Mieru traffic through WARP [Y/n]: AmneziaWG is obfuscated WireGuard 1.5 / 2.0 / 3.1. Clients connect over UDP straight to this server,
so it needs no new domain: the panel domain works if it points at this server and is not proxied.
Install AmneziaWG [y/N]: AmneziaWG versions (comma-separated from 1.5, 2.0, 3.1) [1.5,2.0,3.1]: Name or IPv4 address clients dial for AmneziaWG (not proxied) [panel.example.com]: One UDP port per version, in this order, from 1024 to 65535. The free random ports shown are not
well-known, so Enter is the sensible choice.
AmneziaWG UDP ports for versions 1.5, 2.0, 3.1 (3, comma-separated) [25076,11892,13013]: TrustTunnel is AdGuard's HTTP/2 over TLS VPN, TCP only. It shares TCP/443 with the other services
through SNI, so no port and no UDP rule are added. It needs a domain of its own with an A record to this
server, DNS only: do not put a CDN proxy in front of it.
Install TrustTunnel [y/N]: TrustTunnel domain (an A record to this server, DNS only; its own name, not one used above): ACME email: Name of the first MTProxy and Mieru user (the panel login is always owner): Password of the panel login owner (blank to generate one): Repeat the panel password: Open the installer's ports in UFW (fresh host only) [Y/n]:
